parts.name: S1 transfer: mean (E_64 - E_32 at the same lengths) >= -0.15
S1 transfer: mean (E_64 - E_32 at the same lengths) <= 0.15
S5 refinement, prompt (m 0): mean (episode r_in - r_in_twin) >= 0
S6 refinement, late (m 2): mean ((E - r_in) - (E_twin - r_in_twin)) <= -0.05
S8 FIT, late (m 2, 4): mean (E at (2 lam, 2 w, 2 L) - E at (lam, w, L)) <= 0

reported.name: F3 full refinement, prompt (m 0): mean (E_refined - E_32 at the same x) >= -0.1
F3 full refinement, prompt (m 0): mean (E_refined - E_32 at the same x) <= 0.1
F4 full refinement, late (m 2): mean (E_refined - E_32 at the same x) <= -0.02
F5 full refinement, prompt (m 0): mean (episode r_in refined - r_in at 32, the same x) >= 0.02
F6 full refinement, late (m 2): mean (E - model) <= -0.04
R1 refinement, late (m 2): mean (episode r_in - r_in_twin)
R2 refinement, prompt (m 0): mean ((E - r_in) - (E_twin - r_in_twin)) <= 0
R3 refinement, late (m 2), L 4: mean (E - E_twin)
R3 refinement, late (m 2), L 8: mean (E - E_twin)
R3 refinement, late (m 2), L 16: mean (E - E_twin)

statements.claim: more cells at the same lengths leave the reconstruction unchanged
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the transfer conditions, the mean of E at 64 x 64 less the FIT stage's E at the same lengths lies within [-0.15, 0.15], else FAILS

statements.claim: the frozen model predicts the larger sheet at the same lengths
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the transfer conditions, the mean of E less the frozen model lies within [-0.15, 0.15], else FAILS

statements.claim: doubling every declared length leaves the prompt signal's reconstruction unchanged
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the refined conditions with the prompt signal (m 0), the mean of E less E of the twin lies within [-0.1, 0.1], else FAILS

statements.claim: doubling every declared length lowers the late signal's reconstruction
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the refined conditions with the signal at 2 T* (m 2), the mean of E less E of the twin is <= -0.05, else FAILS

statements.claim: doubling every declared length does not lower the episode's own repair under the prompt signal
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the refined conditions with m 0, the mean of the episode's r_in less the twin's is >= 0, else FAILS

statements.claim: the late signal's loss under doubling is the successor's, not the episode's
statements.rule: HOLDS if, over the refined conditions with m 2, the mean of (E - r_in) less the twin's (E - r_in) is <= -0.05, else FAILS
HOLDS if, at w 16, the mean over (L, arm) of E with the patch mid-stripe less E with it straddling a wall is >= 0, else FAILS

statements.claim: within one sheet, doubling every declared length lowers a late signal's reconstruction
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the FIT stage, over every pair of conditions with the same delay (m 2 or 4) and commitment, one at (2 lam, 2 w, 2 L) and one at (lam, w, L), the mean of E at the doubled lengths less E at the undoubled is <= 0, else FAILS
